content.text: Night waking at 8 is pretty common when something's shifted — a new school year coming, more homework, social stress, or just a light-sleep phase landing at the wrong time. The most effective thing to try is a short, consistent wind-down routine that starts 30 minutes before bed: same order every night, low light, no screens, so her brain gets a clear "we're done" signal.

input.offer: Want the full sleep plan for her age? Reply YES and I'll send it night by night.
